question.text: Let $A=\{(x, y): 2 x+3 y=23, x, y \in \mathbb{N}\}$ and $B=\{x:(x, y) \in A\}$. Then the number of one-one functions from $A$ to $B$ is equal to _______

solution.text:
$\begin{array}{ll} 2 x+3 y=23 \\ x=1 & y=7 \\ x=4 & y=5 \\ x=7 & y=3 \\ x=10 & y=1 \\ A & B \\ (1,7) & 1 \\ (4,5) & 4 \\ (7,3) & 7 \\ (10,1) & 10 \end{array}$
The number of one-one functions from $A$ to $B$ is equal to 4 !
